turns.text: I'm afraid I won't be back in time.
Maybe I can help you later in the day if you still need it.
turns.zh: 如果你还需要的话，我今天晚些时候也许能帮你。

turns.text: That's so kind of you, but don't worry about it.
turns.zh: 你太好了，不过别放在心上。

turns.text: Thanks for even thinking about it.
turns.zh: 谢谢你还能想到这件事。
